[עָרֹם LagBN 31] verb be shrewd, crafty (Late Hebrew id., Hiph`il; Arabic , , be ill-natured, cross; ᵑ7 adjective עָרִים shrewd, Syriac id., and verb in derived species (Pe`al in Lexicons)); —

Qal Infinitive absolute in עָרֹם יַעְרִם 1Sam 23:22 he is exceedingly crafty. Hiph`il Imperfect be crafty, 3 masculine singular יַעְרִם 1Sam 23:22 be or become shrewd יַעְרִם Prov 15:5; Prov 19:25 all these Qal Imperfect in ִ֯ according to BaZMG xliii (1889), 180 so Ges«GKC:63n»§ 63n BuhlLex, but perhaps read יֶעְרַם as Qal; true Hiph`il in 3 masculine plural יַעֲרִימוּ סוֺד Ps 83:4 they make crafty (their) counsel against thy people.
